headline: Adobe, Veeam and Juniper patch critical flaws; Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767 exploitation attempts; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day patched

bullets.text: New: Adobe, Veeam and Juniper Networks have released patches for critical vulnerabilities. The report leads the Google Brotli story, now covered by six outlets, with Brotli CVE-2026-111497 and Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 on CISA's KEV list.
Exploitation attempts have begun against Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw CVE-2026-101767, days after Oracle patched it. Five outlets are tracking Oracle EBS.

Cisco patched CVE-2026-76418, an actively exploited ASA and FTD VPN zero-day used to crash SSL VPN devices, its second firewall VPN zero-day since August. Cisco SD-WAN zero-day exploitation has been tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network.

Attackers turned GitHub issues into a supply-chain campaign against 61 public repositories in under an hour. Separately, an attacker tried to exploit Alpine Linux's GitLab via CVSS 10.0 flaw CVE-2026-97229.

KEV deadlines: PHP2Shell CVE-2026-109618/109619 was due today, with fixes in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; Linux kernel CVE-2026-46300 is due 2026-10-31; VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709, used as a zero-day by China-linked actors, is due 2026-11-11.

Breaches: 2.6 million records stolen from Sony's ISP So-net; hacktivists leaked records on 41,000 DHS staff including undercover ICE agents; iRhythm toll put at 8.2 million; a cyberattack disrupted Belgian tax services.

actions: Review today's Adobe, Veeam and Juniper advisories and schedule the critical fixes for any of those products you run.
Confirm Oracle's patch for E-Business Suite CVE-2026-101767 is applied and check EBS logs for exploitation attempts.
Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418, review VPN logs and crashes, and check SD-WAN against Cisco's advisories.
Check public GitHub repos for unexpected issues, commits or workflow runs; limit token permissions for issue-triggered workflows.
Finish PHP updates to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 now, and apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31.
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 despite its low score, and Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 by 2026-11-10.
